description: Source code for MAX31855 thermocouple-to-digital converter driver, including SPI communication, temperature reading, and error handling.

methods.name: showEgtInfo
methods.description: Displays SPI configuration and channel info for EGT sensors.

methods.name: getMcCode
methods.description: Returns string description for error codes.

methods.name: getResultCode
methods.description: Interprets EGT packet data to determine sensor status.

methods.name: readEgtPacket
methods.description: Reads a data packet from the MAX31855 sensor via SPI.

methods.name: getEgtValue
methods.description: Returns temperature value or error code for a specified channel.

methods.name: egtRead
methods.description: Reads and logs EGT sensor data.

methods.name: initMax31855
methods.description: Initializes the MAX31855 driver with SPI configuration and sets up console commands.
